**Rollback/Regeneration System:** The documentation does not address arena restoration or block regeneration between matches. This feature is not discussed in the provided content.

## A) SKYWARS

### A1. SpigotMC 69436 — "SkywarsReloaded UPDATED | Recoded"

**The author is NOT "Zeus."** Spiget API resolves resource 69436's author to member ID **253369 = "Devmart"** (identities: GitHub `lukasvdgaag`, Discord `GCNT#0001`, gcnt.net). Devmart is the rebrand of GCNT (GaagjesCraft Network Team), run by Lukas van der Gaag. I found no trace of anyone named Zeus attached to this resource. The jar's own `plugin.yml` says `author: Devmart (GCNT)`.

- Full title: `SkywarsReloaded UPDATED | Recoded | 1.21 Support! | NEW: DecentHolograms | Supports all MC versions!`
- **Last updated: 2025-09-13** (11 months ago), version **5.6.34**
- **161,764 downloads**, rating **4.3/5 from 198 reviews**
- Source: https://github.com/lukasvdgaag/SkyWarsReloaded — last push **2025-11-02**, 63★, 40 forks, 27 open issues, not archived, **no LICENSE file at all**

**Where the external download actually lives:** Devmart's own panel, **My GCNT** — not GitHub, not BuiltByBit, not Discord. The GitHub repo has **zero releases**.

**Direct jar URL (verified working today):**
```
https://my.gcnt.net/plugins/SkyWarsReloaded/download/5.6.34
```
`HTTP 200`, `content-type: application/octet-stream`, `content-disposition: attachment; filename="SkyWarsReloaded 5.6.34.jar"`, 872,870 bytes. No login, no CAPTCHA, plain `curl` works. (`my.devmart.net/...` 302s to the same URL.)

**Maintenance reality — be skeptical.** The update feed is: 2025-09-13, 2025-09-02, 2024-10-07, 2024-09-28, 2023-10-31, 2023-06-16. That's ~2 substantive updates in 24 months.

**Hard version ceiling (this is the big one).** I unpacked the jar: NMS handler modules top out at **`v1_21_R1`**. Current Paper is **26.2 / 26.1.2 / 1.21.11**. `NMSUtils` contains `"It seems like we have not validated this newer version of Spigot/Bukkit"` / `"We will try to load the plugin with the latest supported version"` — so it silently falls back to a 1.21.0 handler. On 26.x that will break. There's also an embedded warning: `"SlimeWorldManager cannot be used on 1.20 or higher"`. **Treat SWR as safe only up to ~1.21.1.**

Recent review, 2026-06-24, 1★: *"This plugin malfunctions every time an arena is created and saved. After a server restart, the plugin forgets all arena data, making it impossible to join the arena."* Another 2026-06-09: *"the download nor the discord link works"* (download works now).

**v6 rewrite:** https://www.gcnt.net/skywars/rewrite states no ETA; reporting elsewhere says stalled indefinitely with the team seeking someone to take over. v6 would drop Bukkit world folders for WorldEdit schematics / SlimeWorlds. Don't plan around it.

### A2. Original SkyWarsReloaded (Walrusone) — dead

- `github.com/walrusone/SkyWarsReloaded` — **last push 2019-03-01**, 23★, 51 forks
- Spigot 15325 `SkyWarsReloaded` — last update **2015-12-06**, 968 downloads
- GCNT's README: *"the old SkyWarsReloaded plugin is no longer being maintained by the original author and this is the official replacement."*
- `dev-mart/SkyWarsReloaded` is a stale mirror — last commit 2023-01-04, 2★. Ignore it.

### A3. Actively maintained SkyWars on Modrinth / GitHub / Hangar

| Plugin | URL | Last update | DLs | bStats servers | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SkyWars+ | modrinth.com/plugin/skywars+ | **2025-09-11** (v0.4.0) | 1,338 | n/a | Alpha-grade but preset-friendly |
| MythicSkywars | modrinth.com/plugin/mythicskywars | 2026-08-10 (nightly) | 736 | **0** | **Do not ship — see below** |
| RealSkywars | modrinth.com/plugin/realskywars | 2025-06-02 | 910 | 4 | Marginal; needs WorldEdit/FAWE |
| SkyWarsUp (Hangar) | hangar.papermc.io Reactioner/SkyWarsUp | **2024-01-19** | 125 | — | Abandoned |

**Hangar has essentially nothing for SkyWars.** One result, last touched Jan 2024, 125 downloads. Paper's official repo has not picked up this genre.

**MythicSkywars is a repackaged SkyWarsReloaded.** I downloaded and unpacked the 6.8 MB jar. Evidence: `plugin.yml` name is literally `Skywars`, `api-version: 1.13`, version string `5.6.40-nightly.39` (continuing SWR's 5.6.x lineage past 5.6.34), and it contains SWR's exact private resource set — `config112.yml`, `config18.yml`, `glasscolors18.yml`, `killsounds112.yml`, `taunts18.yml` — plus the identical NMS module set (`v1_8_R3` … `v1_21_R1`) with `v26_1_R1` bolted on. Package renamed to `systems.mythical.mythicskywars`. Upstream has **no LICENSE file**, so redistribution rights are unclear at best. It bundles MySQL *and* MongoDB drivers. GitHub `MythicalLTD/MythicSkyWars`: 1★, MIT claimed, nightly builds only. bStats: **0 servers**. It is currently the only SkyWars build with a 26.x NMS module, which is tempting — resist it.

**SkyWars+** is the most preset-friendly modern option: `loaders: [paper]`, MC 1.21–1.21.11, map system is "drop world folders into `plugins/SkyWarsPlus/maps/` and describe them in `map_data.yml`". Caveats: version 0.4.0, 7 followers, no update in 11 months, no 26.x support, single unproven author.

### A4. CRITICAL — maps. Answer: no maps, no map store, admin supplies everything.

**Verified by opening the jar.** SkyWarsReloaded 5.6.34 contains **zero** maps, schematics, NBT, or world data. The complete non-class payload is config YAML: `config.yml`, `config18.yml`, `config112.yml`, `chest.yml`/`opchest.yml`/`basicchest.yml` + center variants, `mapFile.yml` (an empty per-map *template*, `creator: GCNT`), `worlds.yml`, `messages.yml`, `kits`-adjacent cosmetics, `tables.sql`. There is no map download system anywhere in the plugin, and no map-store command.

**Creating an arena** (https://www.gcnt.net/skywars/creating-arenas.php): `/swm create <name>` drops you in an empty **void world**, you build the islands by hand, then `/swm spawn player` at each spawn (places a diamond block), `/swm spawn spec`, place chests (auto-register), `/swm min`, `/swm creator`, `/swm name`, `/swm save`, `/swm register`.

**Importing an existing world** (https://www.gcnt.net/skywars/importing-arenas) — three routes, explicitly ranked easy→hard:

1. **Extension route** — `/swm import <world>`, one command. **Requires the paid SkywarsReloaded Extension**: spigot resource 69111, **€2.99**, last updated **2024-06-02**, 7,385 downloads, title caps at 1.20x.
2. **WorldEdit route** — `//pos1` `//pos2` `//copy`, `/swm create`, `//paste`, `/swm save`, `/swm register`.
3. **Folder route (free and fully automatable)** — copy `data/`, `region/`, `level.dat`, `uid.dat` into `plugins/Skywars/maps/<name>/` (after `/swm create` + save + register), restart, then `/swm legacyload` to auto-register chests and beacon spawnpoints.

I confirmed route 1's paywall from bytecode: the free jar's `/swmap` subcommand set is `create, edit, save, register, unregister, delete, addspawn, name, creator, min, teamsize, chesttype, checkchesttype, arena, list, legacyload, refreshdata, debug`. **There is no `import` command in the free build.**

**World manager:** SWR ships **its own** (`FileWorldManager` copies world folders) plus built-in optional adapters for SWM/ASWM/ASP (`CommonSWMWorldManager`, `ASWMWorldManager`, `LegacySWMWorldManager`; `config.yml` has `slimeworldmanager: {enable: false, source: file}`). Everything else is **softdepend only** — Vault, PlaceholderAPI, MVdWPlaceholderAPI, HolographicDisplays, DecentHolograms, Multiverse-Core, PerWorldInventory, WorldEdit, PartyAndFriends, SlimeWorldManager, My_Worlds. **Nothing is a hard dependency.** WorldEdit is only needed in practice for import route 2.

### A5. Hosting companies

- **Apex Hosting** — has a one-click "SkyWars" gametype. The game plugin **is SkyWarsReloaded**, inside a 27-plugin bundle (Multiverse-Core, PermissionsEx, FAWE, HolographicDisplays, FeatherBoard, ViaVersion, ProtocolLib, EssentialsX…). Apex ships **their own maps**: the 2018 announcement lists Caves/Ruins/Desert; the 2022 gametype guide lists solo arenas Trees, Cake, Dawn, Mythic and team arenas Mars, Pines, Japan, Memorial, Palace. Their docs never tell users to download maps — because Apex built or licensed them in-house. Not redistributable. Stack is dated (PermissionsEx is long dead). https://apexminecrafthosting.com/guides/minecraft/gametypes/skywars-server/ and https://apexminecrafthosting.com/blog/sky-wars/
- **ScalaCube** — "Oak Network Minigames" one-click game server (Control Panel → Add Game Server → Oak Network Minigames), advertised as 13 minigames incl. SkyWars and HungerGames. Proprietary bundle, no plugin/map detail published. https://scalacube.com/store/minecraft/minigame-skywars
- **Shockbyte / BisectHosting** — no dedicated SkyWars or Hunger Games knowledgebase article exists. They only have generic modpack/server-type installers.

**Net:** every "one-click SkyWars" in the market is a proprietary in-house map bundle. Nobody ships free maps with the plugin, and no free legal map pack exists that you can bundle — the community sources (Planet Minecraft, CurseForge, BuiltByBit) are per-map licenses you'd have to clear individually.

---

## B) SURVIVAL GAMES / HUNGER GAMES

**Your premise is wrong — this genre is in better shape than SkyWars.** Blunt inversion of the expected answer.

### B1–B2. The named resources, checked

| Resource | Last update | Downloads | Download type | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Survival Games Reloaded (spigot **17740**) | **2020-01-19** | 48,372 | External → GitHub `ThunderGemios10/SurvivalGamesReloaded` release `0.5.9` | **Dead** |
| BukkitGames (spigot **279**) | **2018-01-20** | 52,272 | Direct .jar | **Dead** |
| Vanilla Hunger Games (spigot **111881**) | **2026-02-20** | 1,844 | Direct .jar | **Alive**, tiny |
| Hunger Games Plugin (spigot **127328**) | **2026-01-06** | **379** | Direct .jar | Alive but unverifiable |

- **BukkitGames**: MC 1.7–1.12, Bitbucket source. Do not use.
- **Vanilla Hunger Games** (CrazyCranberry, `KevinCranmer/VanillaHungerGames`): genuinely updated — 2026-02-20 "Compiled with 1.21.11", 2025-08-23, 2024-08-04. `api-version: 1.20`, single tiny config, commands `/hgcreate /hgjoin /hgclass`. SMP-flavored, not a network minigame. Not on bStats.
- **Hunger Games Plugin** (Quttor, 127328): 379 downloads, 1 review, **no source code link, not on bStats**. Closed-source, unknown author, no adoption. Don't ship it.

### B3. The actually-good options (none of which you found)

| Plugin | URL | Last update | DLs | bStats servers | MC support |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **HungerGames (ShaneBee)** | modrinth.com/plugin/hungergames-sb | **2026-07-28** (v5.1.1) | 1,395 | **42** | 1.21.11, 26.1.x, **26.2** |

| HungerGameSSS | modrinth.com/plugin/hungergamesss | 2026-07-01 | 1,153 | — | 1.21.7–1.21.11 |
| HungerGames (Hangar) | hangar.papermc.io CantankerousAlly/HungerGames | 2025-03-31 | 272 | 11 | — |

**ShaneBeeStudios/HungerGames is the clear winner and it's a genuinely modern Paper plugin.** I verified by unpacking `HungerGames-5.1.1.jar`: it ships a **`paper-plugin.yml`** (not a legacy `plugin.yml`) with `api-version: '1.21.11'`, uses CommandAPI with per-version modules through `commandapi-bukkit-26.1`, and declares Vault / PlaceholderAPI / MythicMobs as optional. GPL-3.0, GitHub 38★, last push 2026-07-28. Direct jar:
```
https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/UPP8KYnj/versions/l3QYvO8R/HungerGames-5.1.1.jar
```
Author is ShaneBee (SkBee/Skript ecosystem) — a known, long-lived dev. Its own README: *"I took a good 4 years off this plugin, but it's back with a fancy new inside."* That gap is why it looks dead from a naive Spigot search — it never had a Spigot listing revival, it moved to Modrinth.

**Apex Hosting's premade "Hunger Games" gametype uses exactly this plugin** (the `/hg create`, `/hg addspawn`, `/hg setlobbywall`, `/hg bordercenter` command set and Apex's verbatim description match ShaneBee's). Note Apex pins it to **Minecraft 1.16.5** with a guide from **June 2019** — their bundle is ancient even though the plugin isn't. Their maps: Chernobyl, Breeze, Lost, City. https://apexminecrafthosting.com/guides/minecraft/gametypes/survival-games-server/

### B4. Maps — and why this genre is actually *easier* to preset than SkyWars

None of them ship or auto-download maps. **But they don't need one.** ShaneBee's arenas are **cuboid regions selected with a stick tool inside any existing world** — his own docs: *"Arenas don't require their own world, you can have as many in each world as you want."* Setup is `/hg create <name> <min> <max> <time> [cost]`, right-click blocks to place spawns, `/hg debug` to validate. Ayman's ships an **empty 0-byte `arena.yml`**; Vanilla Hunger Games runs in the live world too.

That means a Survival Games preset can generate an ordinary world at provision time and script the arena region — **no map asset, no licensing problem, no world-folder copying.** SkyWars cannot do this: it fundamentally requires hand-built floating islands.

**Don't kill the Survival Games preset. Kill or heavily caveat the SkyWars one.**

- **Survival Games: SHIP IT.** ShaneBeeStudios HungerGames 5.1.1 — updated last month, supports current Paper 26.2, GPL-3.0 (legally redistributable with a source offer), 42 live bStats servers, direct Modrinth CDN jar, no map dependency, and it's the same plugin Apex uses.
